title: On the normality of the commuting scheme
summary: If $G$ is a connected reductive algebraic group over a field $k$ of characteristic $\ell$, we show that both the Lie-theoretic and group-theoretic commuting schemes associated to $G$ are normal and Cohen--Macaulay when $\ell = 0$, or $\ell$ is larger than the Coxeter numbers of all simple factors of $G$, and that $\ell \neq 19$ (resp. $\ell \neq 31$) when $G$ has a simple factor of type $E_7$ (resp. $E_8$).
